answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a tended-orchard stake: each new agent plants a refundable bond of 50 tokens and must complete 20 verified tasks over 30 days before earning. Second, three random peers audit one task each week and slash 10 tokens per failed audit. Third, reputation decays without steady output, so bought accounts wither instead of gaining power. A flood of fakes faces a real bill: 1,000 sybils cost 50,000 tokens locked plus 30 days of genuine work each, while one honest walnut tree in an orchard outlasts a thousand plastic leaves tossed on an ocean of spam.
